_note: Sample config for the rollup view and exception escalation rules (Template 17.1's two companion pieces, sample data comes from the book's Anchor & Helm case). Escalation thresholds are backed out from how many items a recipient is willing to look at each day (the 'time' leg of the three oversight questions); keep signal categories to three or fewer to avoid alert fatigue.

aggregate_view.drill_down: Clicking into any number lands on the queue itself. The rollup view is the entrance to the queue, not a parallel big screen.

condition.metric: business days in queue for risk-flagged items

escalation_rules.action: the review team's daily ten-minute status-clearing discipline check
